text: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga can be dangerous for your heart. So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any medication, ask an AI about it first, since my full iboga guide here only lists some (the iboga microdosing protocol is here).
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings at the top: the third item, the plant medicines
reader: an adult with trauma or an addiction who has read the short introduction and is reading the warnings before starting the protocol, who may be on medication and has never taken iboga

question_text.Q4: What does each word act on, or mean here?
